DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_diario CASCADE;

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_diario AS
SELECT
  data,
  EXTRACT(DOW FROM data)::int                                   AS dia_semana,
  CASE EXTRACT(DOW FROM data)
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Domingo'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Segunda'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Terça'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Quarta'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Quinta'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Sexta'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Sábado'
  END                                                           AS dia_semana_nome,
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM data) IN (0, 6)
    THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE
  END                                                           AS eh_dia_util,
  TO_CHAR(data, 'YYYY-MM')                                      AS ano_mes,
  filial_nome,
  filial_estado,
  filial_regiao,
  grupo_veiculo,
  COUNT(*)                                                      AS qtd_passagens,
  COUNT(DISTINCT placa)                                         AS qtd_veiculos,
  ROUND(SUM(valor)::numeric, 2)                                 AS total_valor,
  ROUND(
    SUM(valor)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)
  , 4)                                                          AS ticket_medio
FROM torre.gold_truckpag_pedagio
WHERE filial_nome IS NOT NULL
  AND placa_tipo IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9
WITH DATA;

CREATE INDEX idx_mv_kpis_ped_diario_data
  ON torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_diario (data);
CREATE INDEX idx_mv_kpis_ped_diario_ano_mes
  ON torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_diario (ano_mes);
CREATE INDEX idx_mv_kpis_ped_diario_filial
  ON torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_diario (filial_nome);

SELECT 'MV gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_diario criada' AS status;

-- 1. Totais gerais
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT data)                          AS dias_na_mv,
  COUNT(*)                                      AS linhas_mv,
  MIN(data)                                     AS data_mais_antiga,
  MAX(data)                                     AS data_mais_recente,
  SUM(qtd_passagens)                            AS total_passagens,
  ROUND(SUM(total_valor)::numeric, 2)           AS total_gasto
FROM torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_diario;

-- 2. Média diária por tipo de dia (útil vs fim de semana) — últimos 30 dias
SELECT
  eh_dia_util,
  dia_semana_nome,
  COUNT(DISTINCT data)                              AS qtd_dias,
  ROUND(AVG(total_por_dia)::numeric, 2)             AS media_valor_dia,
  ROUND(AVG(passagens_por_dia)::numeric, 0)         AS media_passagens_dia
FROM (
  SELECT
    data,
    eh_dia_util,
    dia_semana_nome,
    SUM(total_valor)    AS total_por_dia,
    SUM(qtd_passagens)  AS passagens_por_dia
  FROM torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_diario
  WHERE data >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
    AND data < CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY data, eh_dia_util, dia_semana_nome
) diarios
GROUP BY eh_dia_util, dia_semana_nome
ORDER BY eh_dia_util DESC, dia_semana_nome;

-- 3. Últimos 7 dias: total diário para checar série recente
SELECT
  data,
  dia_semana_nome,
  eh_dia_util,
  SUM(qtd_passagens)                    AS passagens,
  SUM(qtd_veiculos)                     AS veiculos,
  ROUND(SUM(total_valor)::numeric, 2)   AS total_valor
FROM torre.gold_mv_kpis_pedagio_diario
WHERE data >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
GROUP BY data, dia_semana_nome, eh_dia_util
ORDER BY data DESC;
